import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from validate import validate_plan
n=48
links=[]
for u in range(n): links.append((u,(u+1)%n))
rr=random.Random(9)
while len(links)<128:
    u=rr.randrange(n); v=rr.randrange(n)
    if u!=v and (u,v) not in links and (v,u) not in links: links.append((u,v))
rr2=random.Random(9); sel=rr2.sample(range(n),32)
parts=[(v,1) for v in sorted(sel)]
caps=[100 for _ in links]
d=json.loads(open('big4.out').read().splitlines()[1])
errs=validate_plan(d['plan'], n, links, caps, parts, {v:1 for v,_ in parts}, None)
print('errors:', errs[:5] if errs else 'NONE')
"
